items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I never did play with him, but I knew him good.

ctx.x: Yeah, well now there was a George Bakke too. Yeah. That was his brother. But he couldn't pass, I don't believe he was white enough. No, but Achille must have been lighter than him. Yeah, he must have been. Yeah. George Bakke, I knew him good too.
I never did play with him, but I knew him good.
That's what you knew a lot of musicians that you never played with.
